title: Decoupled observability-credit experiment and compliance/SLA add-on flow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: validate a decoupled observability-credit product that customers can purchase independently of base retention tiers, and test a bundled compliance-pack + premium SLA as a purchasable add-on. We want to measure uplift in paid addons attach rate, impact on upsell MRR, and support/legal overhead from contract/security-questionnaire changes.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment is implemented behind a feature flag for 15% of eligible accounts
Telemetry shows addon attach rate and upgrade funnel for trials and paid customers
Billing records (test) reflect addon SKU separately and apply correctly to invoices
Legal/solutions has a draft SCO/contract language template for compliance-pack and SLA
No customer support regression in first 2 weeks (tracked via support ticket rate)
experiment_plan: Cohorts: 15% treatment (show decoupled credits + compliance/SLA upsell), 85% control (current bundle UI)

Pricing: observability-credit packs (10k/50k/250k token-minutes) priced to approximate current blended revenue; compliance-pack at fixed $5k/yr; premium SLA as % uplift (20% of committed) or fixed as pilot.
Gating: UI show only to orgs with > $5k/mo usage OR enterprise trial flagged; backend entitlement toggles created (entitlement keys: obs_credit_pack, compliance_pack, premium_sla)
Metrics: addon attach rate, conversion to paid, ARPA uplift (90d), churn delta, support ticket delta, contract turnaround time, questionnaire completion %
Rollout: internal pilot (SEs + 3 existing enterprise customers) -> 15% public experiment -> evaluate at 30d -> increase or kill
Success thresholds: attach rate >= 2.5% of treatment AND 90d ARPA uplift >= $120/customer (net of credits cost)
